---
title: "ssoossh ssh login"
description: "Sign in through the browser and load a signed SSH certificate into the agent (or files)."
---

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in client/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Generates a fresh keypair, sends the public key to the ssoossh server, opens your browser so you can sign in and approve, and waits for the server to deliver the signed certificate. Used from ssh_config's `Match exec`, or by hand before a session.

A certificate that is already loaded and still valid is reused rather than replaced, so one approval covers every connection until it expires. Pass --force to replace it with a new one.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh ssh login [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
# Get a certificate, or reuse the valid one already loaded
  ssoossh ssh login

  # Replace the loaded certificate with a new one
  ssoossh ssh login --force

  # An RSA key, and no agent forwarding on the certificate
  ssoossh ssh login --key-type rsa --key-size 4096 --no-agent-forwarding
```

## Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--force` | bool | `false` | request a new certificate even if a valid one is already loaded |
| `--key-size` | int | `0` | key size: the curve for ecdsa (256, 384 or 521; default 384) or bits for rsa (at least 2048; default 3072); ignored for ed25519 |
| `--key-type` | string |  | key algorithm to generate: ecdsa (the default), ed25519, or rsa |
| `--no-agent-forwarding` | bool | `false` | do not request permit-agent-forwarding extension |
| `--no-port-forwarding` | bool | `false` | do not request permit-port-forwarding extension |
| `--no-pty` | bool | `false` | do not request permit-pty extension |
| `--no-user-rc` | bool | `false` | do not request permit-user-rc extension |
| `--no-x11-forwarding` | bool | `false` | do not request permit-X11-forwarding extension |

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoossh`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to an extra config file, merged after the standard locations |
| `--server` | string |  | server address, e.g. https://ssh.example.com; https is assumed when no scheme is given |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | count | `0` | trace what the command is doing, to stderr; repeat for more (-v steps, -vv requests and files, -vvv bodies) |
